headline: FIRST MINING HITS 73 g/t Au Over 1m at Duparquet — North Zone Delivers Highest-Grade Intercept Yet
snippet: First Mining Gold (FF.TO) released final 2025 drill results from Duparquet in Quebec's Abitibi region: 15.14 g/t Au over 5.0m — including 73.40 g/t Au over 1.0m — at the North Zone, plus 9.87 g/t Au over 2.75m at the newly discovered Minuit target. Results cover 4,329m across 12 holes from a 16,577m campaign.

headline: SIGMA LITHIUM SHARES SINK 15%: Brazilian Court Ruling Hits SGML Day After Record Q1 Earnings
snippet: Sigma Lithium (SGML) is appealing a Brazilian local court ruling carrying a potential US$10M collateral obligation, amid what the company calls a concurrent 'fake news' social media campaign. Shares dropped 15% despite verified environmental compliance and record Q1 2026 earnings — the ruling involves disputed waste management allegations at the Grota do Cirilo operation.

headline: Ghana Demands 30% of Every Ounce: Africa's Top Gold Producer Raises Miner Offtake Target to Build Reserves
snippet: Ghana's central bank is pushing large-scale gold miners to sell 30% of annual output — up from 20% — as the government targets 157 tonnes of reserves by 2028. Pricing and discount talks remain unresolved with the Ghana Chamber of Mines, but reserves have already climbed to 19.2 tonnes on the existing program.

headline: GoldSeek SWOT: Equinox + Orla $18.5B Merger Creates 1.1M-Oz North American Gold Giant
snippet: This week's Gold SWOT highlights Equinox Gold and Orla Mining's definitive all-share combination, creating North America's new senior gold producer at a ~$18.5B implied market cap. The merged entity targets 1.1 million oz in 2026 with a funded development pipeline toward 1.9 million oz annually across six operating mines in Canada, the U.S., Mexico, and Nicaragua.

headline: Royal Gold Converts Hod Maden Equity to Royalty Stream, Cuts Direct Stake from 30% to 15%
snippet: Royal Gold (RGLD) halved its direct equity in Turkey's Hod Maden gold-copper project and secured a new 2.5% NSR royalty in exchange. SSR Mining exits the JV entirely, selling to partner Lidya Madençilik, which assumes operatorship. Royal Gold expects ~9,000 GEOs per year from the combined royalty interests during the first five years of production.

headline: Power Metallic Mines Enters Saudi Arabia — 50/50 JV With Amaar Mining, $10M Work Program Funded
snippet: Power Metallic Mines (TSXV: PNPN) formed a 50/50 joint venture with Saudi Arabia's Amaar Mining to jointly pursue future license rounds in the Jabal Sayid Mineralized Belt, with up to US$10M in initial post-award work-program funding. The deal follows Power Metallic's existing Jabal Baudan exploration license in the same belt.

headline: OPINION: Michael Oliver Warns HISTORIC Gold and Silver Breakout Is Loading as U.S. Debt Hits Structural Tipping Point
snippet: Veteran momentum analyst Michael Oliver argues the current consolidation in gold and silver is the prelude to a structural breakout driven by U.S. debt-to-GDP dynamics. Oliver, founder of Momentum Structural Analysis, says any pullback toward current levels represents a buying opportunity rather than a trend change — and that precious metals are behaving exactly as momentum models predict ahead of a historic move.
